entities.name: Query ACC carboxyltransferase fusion
observations: 768 aa bacterial protein; calculated molecular mass 80.97 kDa and theoretical pI 6.05.
Strong homology to reviewed ACC carboxyl-transferase beta/alpha fusion proteins: 45.3–48.2% identity over approximately 74–75% query coverage, E-values 1.2e-151 to 4.6e-161.
Pfam detects Carboxyl_trans (PF01039) at residues 241–388 and 576–730, plus ACCA (PF03255) at residues 535–766.
Most likely catalyzes the transcarboxylation step of acetyl-CoA carboxylase: transfers CO2 from carboxybiotinylated BCCP to acetyl-CoA, producing malonyl-CoA.
Likely binds one structural Zn2+ ion through a conserved C4 zinc-finger region inferred from homologous ACC beta/alpha proteins; direct metal binding is not experimentally established for this query.
Expected to be cytosolic and part of a heterotetrameric ACC complex with AccB and AccC plus two copies of the beta/alpha carboxyltransferase component; these are homolog-based inferences.

entities.name: Acetyl-CoA carboxylase transcarboxylation
observations: N(6)-carboxybiotinyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + acetyl-CoA = N(6)-biotinyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + malonyl-CoA; mapped to Rhea RHEA:10505, RHEA:10506, and RHEA:54728 in homolog annotations.
This is the transcarboxylase half-reaction of acetyl-CoA carboxylase, associated with EC 2.1.3.15 in reviewed homologs.

entities.name: Malonyl-CoA biosynthesis
observations: The homologous protein is assigned to acetyl-CoA-dependent malonyl-CoA biosynthesis and fatty-acid biosynthesis.
